conditioning_fact: All three source trajectories have exactly the same saved prompt/audio tensors. For a selected trajectory, its prompt input_ids plus token_ids[:j] define an identical token prefix across the three candidate models. Different trajectories must not be described as the same prefix merely because their transcripts normalize equally.
label_preservation: Preserve exact saved IDs including terminal EOS for base/step050 and all512 no-EOS IDs for step100; do not retokenize normalized/reference/parser text into replacement labels. This is an input-data fact, not a final scoring/execution design.
boundary: Only CPU/read-only evidence preparation; no probabilities computed, no models loaded, no generation or training scheduled, no large weights rehashed; final experimental contract is reviewed separately.
